Subject: Request: SCIM deltas and role-owner attestations for SOC2 intake

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the onboarding call yesterday. As part of our SOC2 evidence collection we need a short packet showing recent identity provisioning changes (SCIM deltas), examples of SAML assertions, and a role-owner mapping so our IAM team can validate least-privilege controls. Can you provide the following by EOD Tuesday (June 30)?

- SCIM delta export covering May 1–Jun 23 (CSV is fine) showing adds/updates/deletes with timestamps and actor IDs.
- One redacted SAML assertion (raw XML) that includes NameID and role attributes your service emits.
- RBAC role mapping: role name -> entitlements -> owner (email) - a CSV or spreadsheet.
- A short attestation from an owner that roles are reviewed quarterly (template would be fine).

If there are any concerns about PII in the delta export, tell us how you redact or a safe way to share. CC'ing procurement for any necessary contract attachments.

Appreciate it — we want to close this piece before the auditor kickoff next week.

Regards,
Alex Chen
Security Manager, MedPoint Health
security@medpoint.com

Ben/Aisha — thanks, received the CSVs and they look good for the initial review. Two follow-ups:

1) Can you provide one SAML assertion with only the attributes: NameID, issuer, IssueInstant, and the role attribute? We just need the schema and attribute names — redact any user-specific values.
2) For the role_owner_manifest, can owners confirm via a one-paragraph attestation that the role is scoped to least privilege and reviewed quarterly? If you can attach a single consolidated PDF with owner signatures that would be ideal.

Also — is there a small sample mapping (2–3 rows) that shows how a service account vs. human user appears in the SCIM delta? That helps our IAM team confirm service account handling.

If you can deliver the SAML sample and the consolidated attestation PDF by EOD Mon 6/28, we should be in good shape for the auditor kickoff.

—Alex
